measures.title: Proposition for a Sales Tax Increase in Oklahoma County
measures.summary: Would authorize Oklahoma County to levy a new countywide sales tax of four-tenths of one percent (0.40%), in addition to existing state and local sales taxes. The money would be used to operate, maintain, construct, renovate, finance, equip and staff county detention, diversion, and mental health facilities and programs. The tax would run for 25 years, from April 1, 2027 through March 31, 2052.
measures.yesMeans: Oklahoma County would add a 0.40% sales tax from April 1, 2027 to March 31, 2052 for detention, diversion, and mental health facilities and programs.
measures.noMeans: The new county sales tax would not be levied.
